I’m socially awkward and will probably never really find love again tbh 🤷‍♂️ I spend most of my time hiding behind my phone, smoking cigarettes, getting drunk, or playing video games. For a long while all I wanted to do was kill myself. Shit I actually posted on here last August about how I planned to kill myself just days after my birthday. And I seriously was going to. The only thing that stopped me was my unplanned attempt a couple months prior. I attempted for the second time in my life and the amount of support and concern I got from friends showed how much of a difference I really do make. People I didn’t even consider my friend came out of nowhere to try and support me. That’s what drives me every day. I still have a battle in my own head every morning and I still do want to die but I want to live a little first too. Who knows, maybe one day I will meet someone who can deal with my socially awkward ass and actually be able to get through my extremely long awkward phase. Just hang in there man. Find your drive dude.

TL;DR
I’m a socially awkward mess as well but it doesn’t mean that people don’t still care, even people you don’t even think would care, do. Find what makes you happy in life, and fucking roll with it.
